newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK to tender 2nd 10-year EF note issue on Jan 27.
newsitem.headline: HK to tender 2nd 10-year EF note issue on Jan 27.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority, the territory's de facto central bank, said on Monday that it will tender its second issue of HK$500 million 10-year exchange fund notes on January 27.
The notes will mature on January 29, 2007, and carry an interest rate of 6.89 percent per annum payable semi-annually in arrears, it said.
In addition to the HK$500 million notes to be offered, another HK$100 million would be held as reserve by the Authority for supply to market makers in the secondary market.
Each tender must be for an amount of HK$50,000 or its integral multiples.
Settlement would take place on January 28.
